note: Body areas for “Where does it hurt?”. Ids match data-id attributes in assets/svg/regions-anterior.svg and, for areas also seen from behind, regions-posterior.svg. "view": "back" marks an area on the back of the body, which needs a shape in the posterior drawing. Urgency: self-care | doctor | urgent.
disclaimer: Corpus is an educational map, not a diagnosis. It can’t examine you or know your history. If you are worried about a symptom, talk to a doctor or pharmacist.
emergency: In an emergency call your local emergency number: 112 (EU), 999 (UK), 911 (US).
redFlags: Chest pain or pressure, especially with breathlessness, sweating, nausea, or pain spreading to the arm, neck or jaw
Signs of stroke: face drooping, arm weakness, slurred speech
A sudden, severe headache, or a headache with fever, stiff neck or rash
Difficulty breathing, choking, or blue lips
Heavy bleeding, vomiting blood, or black tarry stools
Severe abdominal pain with a rigid belly or fainting, or abdominal pain in pregnancy
Fainting, confusion or a seizure

redFlags.text: Sudden, severe pain in a testicle
Heavy bleeding, or severe pain, in pregnancy

regions.name: Head

causes.title: Tension-type headache
causes.signs: Band-like pressure on both sides, often with stress, poor sleep, dehydration or long screen time.

causes.title: Migraine
causes.signs: Throbbing, often one-sided, with nausea and sensitivity to light or sound; sometimes a visual aura first.

causes.title: Sinus pain
causes.signs: Pressure over the forehead or cheeks with a blocked nose after a cold, worse bending forward.

causes.title: Concussion
causes.signs: Headache, dizziness, nausea or confusion after a knock to the head.

causes.title: Medication-overuse headache
causes.signs: Near-daily headaches in someone taking painkillers on most days.

redFlags: A sudden “thunderclap” headache, the worst you’ve ever had
Headache with fever, a stiff neck, a rash or confusion
Headache after a head injury with vomiting, drowsiness or worsening pain
Headache with weakness, numbness, or trouble speaking or seeing
A new headache after 50 with scalp tenderness or jaw pain when chewing

regions.name: Face

causes.title: Sinusitis
causes.signs: Pressure in the cheeks or forehead, blocked nose, thick discharge.

causes.title: Trigeminal neuralgia
causes.signs: Brief electric-shock pains in the face set off by touch, eating or wind.

causes.title: Bell’s palsy
causes.signs: One side of the face droops or won’t move, including the forehead, coming on over a day or two, sometimes with pain behind the ear. Sudden facial weakness can also be a stroke, so get seen the same day.

causes.title: Facial fracture
causes.signs: After a blow: swelling, numbness, a bite that doesn’t meet, or double vision.

causes.title: Nosebleed
causes.signs: Bleeding from one nostril, often after picking, a cold or dry air. Sit up, lean forward and pinch the soft part of the nose for 10 to 15 minutes.

causes.title: Shingles on the face
causes.signs: A burning pain, then a blistering rash on one side of the forehead or face. See a doctor within 3 days, and the same day if it is near the eye.

redFlags: Sudden drooping of one side of the face (possible stroke)
Facial swelling that is spreading fast, or swelling with difficulty swallowing or breathing
A hot, red, swollen area around the eye or nose with fever

regions.name: Eye

causes.title: Conjunctivitis
causes.signs: A red, gritty or itchy eye with watery or sticky discharge, often in both eyes, while your sight stays normal. It usually clears in one to two weeks.

causes.title: Dry eyes
causes.signs: Burning, gritty or tired eyes, worse with screens, heating, air conditioning or wind.

causes.title: Stye or eyelid lump
causes.signs: A tender red lump on the edge of the eyelid that usually settles in a week or two with warm compresses.

causes.title: Scratch or something in the eye
causes.signs: Sharp pain, watering and a feeling that something is there, after dust, a fingernail or a contact lens. If it isn’t better within a day, see a pharmacist, optician or doctor.

causes.title: Red or painful eye
causes.signs: A red, sore or gritty eye. Pain with blurred vision or light sensitivity, or after an injury, needs same-day care.

causes.title: Optic neuritis
causes.signs: Pain on moving one eye, with blurring or faded colours in that eye coming on over a few days.

causes.title: Acute glaucoma
causes.signs: Sudden, severe pain in one eye with redness, blurred vision, haloes around lights, headache and sometimes vomiting.

causes.title: Double vision
causes.signs: Seeing two of things, side by side or one above the other. If it starts suddenly, especially with a droopy eyelid, a headache, or weakness or numbness elsewhere, get emergency care. Double vision that comes and goes over weeks, worse when tired, also needs a doctor.

redFlags: Sudden loss of sight, or a curtain or shadow across part of your vision
New flashes of light or a shower of new floaters
A chemical splash (rinse with plenty of clean water first), or an injury from something sharp or fast-moving
A painful red eye with blurred vision
Sudden double vision, especially with a droopy eyelid or a headache

regions.name: Ear

causes.title: Middle ear infection
causes.signs: Earache with a cold, sometimes with muffled hearing or a fever. Common in children, and most settle within 3 days.

causes.title: Outer ear infection
causes.signs: An itchy, painful ear canal, worse when the ear is pulled, often after swimming. A pharmacist can help.

causes.title: Earwax build-up
causes.signs: A blocked, full feeling with muffled hearing, sometimes with ringing.

causes.title: Jaw joint pain felt in the ear
causes.signs: Aching in front of the ear, worse when chewing or yawning, often with clicking. The ear itself is healthy.

causes.title: Pain from the throat or teeth
causes.signs: Tonsillitis, a bad tooth or a sore throat can be felt as earache, because they share nerves with the ear.

causes.title: Vertigo
causes.signs: Brief spells of spinning when you move your head (often from loose crystals in the inner ear), or constant dizziness after a cold (inner ear inflammation).

causes.title: Sudden hearing loss
causes.signs: Hearing drops in one ear over hours to a few days, without a cold or earwax. Get seen within a day, because early treatment helps.

redFlags: A red, tender swelling behind the ear that pushes it forward, with a fever
Sudden hearing loss in one ear
Earache with a drooping face, or blisters in or around the ear
Dizziness with a severe headache, double vision, slurred speech or weakness (possible stroke)

regions.name: Jaw & teeth

causes.title: Jaw joint (TMJ) pain
causes.signs: Aching in front of the ear, clicking, pain when chewing, often with clenching or grinding.

causes.title: Dental pain or abscess
causes.signs: Toothache, sensitivity to hot or cold, or a swollen gum or cheek. Swelling or fever needs a dentist promptly.

causes.title: Teeth grinding
causes.signs: An aching jaw, tired face muscles or a headache on waking, sometimes with worn or chipped teeth.

causes.title: Wisdom tooth pain
causes.signs: Pain and swelling at the back of the jaw, sometimes with a bad taste or trouble opening the mouth.

causes.title: Mouth ulcers
causes.signs: Small, painful sores inside the mouth that heal within 2 weeks. One that lasts longer than 3 weeks needs checking.

causes.title: Salivary gland stone or infection
causes.signs: A painful swelling under the jaw or in front of the ear that comes on when you eat.

causes.title: Pain on chewing with a new headache
causes.signs: Jaw tiredness when chewing, with a new headache or a tender scalp, in someone over 50, can be inflamed arteries (giant cell arteritis) and needs treatment the same day to protect your sight.

causes.title: Jaw pain from the heart
causes.signs: An ache in the jaw or neck brought on by effort, or with chest tightness, breathlessness or sweating, can be angina or a heart attack.

causes.title: Broken jaw
causes.signs: After a blow: the teeth don’t meet properly, it hurts to open the mouth, or the lower lip is numb.

redFlags: Jaw pain with chest pain, breathlessness or sweating: call emergency services
Swelling in the face, jaw or floor of the mouth that is spreading, or makes it hard to swallow, breathe or open the mouth
A mouth ulcer, lump or white or red patch that hasn’t healed after 3 weeks
A new headache with jaw pain on chewing after 50

regions.name: Neck

causes.title: Neck strain
causes.signs: Stiffness and pain after sleeping awkwardly, long desk work or a jolt.

causes.title: Pinched nerve
causes.signs: Neck pain shooting into the arm with tingling, numbness or weakness.

causes.title: Wry neck
causes.signs: Waking with the head stuck turned to one side, painful to straighten. It usually eases within a few days to a week.

causes.title: Wear in the neck
causes.signs: Stiffness and aching that come and go with age, sometimes with grinding when you turn your head. Gentle movement helps.

causes.title: Whiplash
causes.signs: Neck pain and stiffness coming on in the hours after a sudden jolt, such as a car being hit from behind.

redFlags: Neck pain after a significant injury such as a fall or car crash: keep still and get help
Fever with a stiff neck, headache or rash
Neck pain with arm weakness or clumsy hands
A lump in the side of the neck that is growing or hasn’t gone after 3 weeks

regions.name: Throat

causes.title: Sore throat or tonsillitis
causes.signs: Pain on swallowing, sometimes with white patches on the tonsils and tender glands under the jaw, during a cold. Most get better within a week.

causes.title: Hoarse voice (laryngitis)
causes.signs: A hoarse, weak or lost voice after a cold or a lot of talking or shouting. See a doctor if it lasts more than 3 weeks.

causes.title: Reflux
causes.signs: Burning in the throat and a sour taste, worse lying down.

causes.title: Lump in the throat feeling
causes.signs: A feeling of something stuck in the throat between meals, while food and drink go down normally. It is common, harmless and often linked to reflux or stress.

causes.title: Thyroid lump or swelling
causes.signs: A lump at the front of the neck that moves when you swallow.

causes.title: Trouble swallowing
causes.signs: Food sticking on the way down, or swallowing that is getting harder over weeks.

causes.title: Quinsy (abscess beside a tonsil)
causes.signs: A severe sore throat on one side, getting worse, with difficulty swallowing or opening the mouth, a muffled voice and fever.

causes.title: Food stuck in the gullet
causes.signs: A feeling of food stuck after swallowing, with drooling or being unable to swallow your own saliva.

redFlags: Difficulty breathing, noisy breathing, drooling or being unable to swallow saliva
Swelling of the lips, tongue or throat with a rash or breathlessness (possible severe allergic reaction): call emergency services
A hoarse voice for more than 3 weeks, especially if you smoke
Swallowing that keeps getting harder, or weight loss you can’t explain

regions.name: Shoulder

causes.title: Rotator cuff problem
causes.signs: Pain on the outer shoulder when lifting the arm, and pain at night lying on it.

causes.title: Frozen shoulder
causes.signs: Gradually increasing pain and stiffness in every direction.

causes.title: AC joint injury
causes.signs: Pain at the top of the shoulder after falling onto it; a bump may appear.

causes.title: Dislocation or fracture
causes.signs: After a fall: deformity and unable to move the arm.

causes.title: Referred pain
causes.signs: Shoulder pain can come from the neck, or from the diaphragm, gallbladder or heart irritating shared nerves.

redFlags: Shoulder or arm pain with chest pressure, breathlessness or sweating: call emergency services
Deformity after an injury, or a cold, numb arm
Shoulder-tip pain after a blow to the abdomen (possible internal bleeding)

regions.name: Armpit

causes.title: Swollen lymph node
causes.signs: A tender lump after an infection in the hand or arm, a recent vaccination or a shaving rash. It usually settles within two or three weeks.

causes.title: Boil or infected hair follicle
causes.signs: A red, hot, tender lump in the skin, sometimes with a yellow head, often after shaving. Warm compresses help. See a doctor if it spreads, grows or you feel unwell.

causes.title: Hidradenitis suppurativa
causes.signs: Painful lumps and abscesses that keep coming back in the armpits or groin, healing with scars. It is treatable, so see a doctor.

causes.title: Muscle strain
causes.signs: Pain at the front or back fold of the armpit after lifting, throwing or pushing, worse using the arm.

causes.title: Breast lump reaching the armpit
causes.signs: Breast tissue extends into the armpit, and breast cancer can spread to these nodes. Any new lump with a change in the breast needs a doctor.

causes.title: Blood clot in the arm
causes.signs: A swollen, heavy, aching or bluish arm, sometimes after heavy repeated arm use or a drip.

redFlags: A hard, fixed or growing lump, especially with a change in the breast
A swollen, discoloured or heavy arm: same-day assessment (possible blood clot)
Spreading redness or red streaks up the arm with fever

regions.name: Centre of the chest

causes.title: Heart attack or angina
causes.signs: Pressure, tightness or heaviness that may spread to the arm, neck, jaw or back, with breathlessness, sweating or nausea.

causes.title: Heartburn / reflux
causes.signs: Burning behind the breastbone after meals or lying down, with a sour taste.

causes.title: Costochondritis
causes.signs: Sharp pain where the ribs meet the breastbone, tender to press and worse with movement.

causes.title: Pericarditis
causes.signs: Sharp central pain, worse lying flat and better leaning forward, often after a viral illness.

causes.title: Anxiety or panic
causes.signs: Chest tightness with a racing heart, fast breathing and tingling. Get chest pain checked before assuming this.

redFlags: Chest pain that lasts more than a few minutes, or comes with breathlessness, sweating, nausea or fainting: call emergency services now
Sudden tearing pain going through to the back

causes.title: Muscle strain or rib injury
causes.signs: Pain on twisting, coughing or pressing one spot, often after exertion or a fall.

causes.title: Pneumonia or pleurisy
causes.signs: Sharp pain on breathing in, with fever and cough.

causes.title: Pulmonary embolism
causes.signs: Sudden sharp pain and breathlessness, maybe with a swollen calf or coughing blood.

causes.title: Collapsed lung
causes.signs: Sudden one-sided chest pain and breathlessness.

causes.title: Shingles
causes.signs: A burning band of pain on one side, followed by a blistering rash. Early treatment helps.

causes.title: Gallbladder pain
causes.signs: Pain under the lower right ribs after fatty meals, sometimes felt in the back.

causes.title: Heart attack or angina
causes.signs: Pressure or tightness that may spread to the left arm, neck or jaw, with breathlessness or sweating.

causes.title: Muscle strain or rib injury
causes.signs: Pain on twisting, coughing or pressing one spot.

causes.title: Pneumonia or pleurisy
causes.signs: Sharp pain on breathing in, with fever and cough.

causes.title: Pulmonary embolism
causes.signs: Sudden sharp pain and breathlessness, maybe with a swollen calf or coughing blood.

causes.title: Collapsed lung
causes.signs: Sudden one-sided chest pain and breathlessness.

causes.title: Shingles
causes.signs: A burning band of pain on one side, followed by a blistering rash.

regions.name: Upper arm

causes.title: Muscle strain
causes.signs: Ache after lifting or unaccustomed exercise, easing over days.

causes.title: Biceps tendon problem
causes.signs: Pain at the front of the shoulder or upper arm. A sudden snap followed by a bulge in the arm suggests a rupture.

causes.title: Fracture
causes.signs: After a fall: severe pain, swelling, unable to use the arm.

causes.title: Referred pain from the neck
causes.signs: Arm pain with tingling that follows a strip of skin, often with neck stiffness.

redFlags: Left arm pain with chest discomfort, breathlessness or sweating: call emergency services

causes.title: Tennis elbow
causes.signs: Pain on the outer elbow when gripping, lifting or turning a handle.

causes.title: Golfer’s elbow
causes.signs: Pain on the inner elbow with gripping.

causes.title: Olecranon bursitis
causes.signs: A soft swelling on the point of the elbow. A red, hot one may be infected.

causes.title: Ulnar nerve irritation
causes.signs: Tingling in the ring and little fingers, worse with the elbow bent.

causes.title: Fracture or dislocation
causes.signs: After a fall: deformity, swelling, can’t bend or straighten the elbow.

causes.title: Overuse / tendon strain
causes.signs: Aching along the forearm after repetitive gripping, typing or tools.

causes.title: Fracture
causes.signs: After a fall: pain, swelling, a bend in the forearm.

causes.title: Compartment syndrome
causes.signs: Severe, increasing pain after a crush or fracture, worse when moving the fingers.

regions.name: Wrist & hand

causes.title: Carpal tunnel syndrome
causes.signs: Tingling or numbness in the thumb, index and middle fingers, often at night.

causes.title: Scaphoid fracture
causes.signs: Pain at the base of the thumb after a fall on an outstretched hand, even if it seems only sprained. Needs an X-ray.

causes.title: Sprain
causes.signs: Pain and swelling after a twist, improving over days.

causes.title: De Quervain’s tenosynovitis
causes.signs: Pain on the thumb side of the wrist when gripping or lifting.

causes.title: Thumb-base arthritis
causes.signs: Aching at the base of the thumb when pinching or opening jars.

causes.title: Trigger finger
causes.signs: A finger catches or locks when bending.

causes.title: Rheumatoid arthritis
causes.signs: Swollen, stiff knuckles on both hands, worse in the morning.

redFlags: A hand that is cold, pale or numb after an injury
A red, hot, swollen joint with fever
A deep cut with loss of movement or feeling in a finger
Redness spreading quickly from a bite or wound

causes.title: Gallstones or gallbladder inflammation
causes.signs: Severe pain under the right ribs, often after fatty food, maybe spreading to the right shoulder blade. Fever or yellow skin makes it urgent.

causes.title: Liver inflammation (hepatitis)
causes.signs: A dull ache with tiredness, nausea, yellow eyes or dark urine.

causes.title: Kidney stone or infection
causes.signs: Pain in the back or side that may wrap round to the front, with fever or urinary symptoms.

causes.title: Muscle or rib strain
causes.signs: Pain on movement or pressing one spot, after exertion or coughing.

causes.title: Shingles
causes.signs: A burning band of pain followed by a blistering rash on one side.

regions.name: Upper middle abdomen

causes.title: Indigestion / gastritis
causes.signs: Burning or gnawing pain under the breastbone, bloating, often linked to meals, alcohol or anti-inflammatory painkillers.

causes.title: Peptic ulcer
causes.signs: Recurring gnawing pain, sometimes at night or when hungry.

causes.title: Gallstones
causes.signs: Severe pain in the upper middle or right, lasting minutes to hours after food.

causes.title: Pancreatitis
causes.signs: Severe pain boring through to the back, with vomiting.

causes.title: Heart attack
causes.signs: Can feel like indigestion, especially in women, older people and people with diabetes.

redFlags: Vomiting blood or “coffee grounds”, or black tarry stools
Severe pain boring through to the back with vomiting
Indigestion-like pain with sweating, breathlessness, or pain spreading to the arm or jaw

causes.title: Indigestion / gastritis
causes.signs: Burning pain and bloating after meals.

causes.title: Trapped wind / IBS
causes.signs: Crampy pain under the left ribs that comes and goes, eased by passing wind.

causes.title: Spleen injury or enlargement
causes.signs: Pain after a blow to the left side, or a dragging ache after glandular fever.

causes.title: Pancreatitis
causes.signs: Severe pain going through to the back, with vomiting.

causes.title: Kidney stone or infection
causes.signs: Flank pain wrapping to the front, with fever or urinary symptoms.

causes.title: Muscle or rib strain
causes.signs: Pain on movement or pressing one spot.

causes.title: Kidney stone
causes.signs: Waves of severe pain from the back or side down toward the groin; can’t get comfortable.

causes.title: Kidney infection
causes.signs: Side or back pain with fever, shivering and burning when passing urine.

causes.title: Muscle strain
causes.signs: Pain on bending or twisting, eased by rest.

causes.title: Constipation
causes.signs: Crampy, bloated feeling with infrequent or hard stools.

causes.title: Shingles
causes.signs: A burning band of pain followed by a rash on one side.

causes.title: Early appendicitis
causes.signs: Pain often starts here before moving to the lower right, with loss of appetite and nausea.

causes.title: Gastroenteritis
causes.signs: Cramps with vomiting or diarrhoea.

causes.title: Constipation / trapped wind / IBS
causes.signs: Bloating and cramps that come and go.

causes.title: Umbilical hernia
causes.signs: A soft bulge at or near the belly button, more obvious when coughing. A painful, hard bulge that won’t go back is urgent.

causes.title: Bowel obstruction
causes.signs: Colicky pain, a swollen belly, vomiting, and no wind or stools.

causes.title: Abdominal aortic aneurysm
causes.signs: In older adults, especially smokers: a pulsing feeling, or sudden severe pain going to the back.

causes.title: Kidney stone
causes.signs: Waves of severe pain from the back or side down toward the groin.

causes.title: Kidney infection
causes.signs: Side or back pain with fever, shivering and burning when passing urine.

causes.title: Muscle strain
causes.signs: Pain on bending or twisting, eased by rest.

causes.title: Constipation / IBS
causes.signs: Crampy pain on the left with bloating and changed bowel habit.

causes.title: Appendicitis
causes.signs: Pain that starts around the navel and moves here, worse with movement, coughing or bumps in the road, with nausea, loss of appetite and fever.

causes.title: Inguinal hernia
causes.signs: A bulge in the groin that appears when standing or straining. A painful, hard bulge that won’t go back is urgent.

causes.title: Kidney stone
causes.signs: Severe pain moving from the side down toward the groin.

causes.title: Crohn’s disease
causes.signs: Recurring pain with diarrhoea and weight loss.

causes.title: Ectopic pregnancy
causes.signs: One-sided low pain in someone who could be pregnant, often with vaginal bleeding, pain at the tip of the shoulder, dizziness or fainting. It is an emergency. One on the right can feel like appendicitis.

causes.title: Ovarian cyst or torsion
causes.signs: A cyst can cause a dull one-sided ache. Sudden, severe pain with vomiting can mean the ovary has twisted, which is an emergency.

causes.title: Trapped wind / constipation
causes.signs: Cramping that comes and goes and eases after a bowel movement.

causes.title: Bladder infection (cystitis)
causes.signs: Low central pain with burning, urgency and passing urine often.

causes.title: Urinary retention
causes.signs: Unable to pass urine, with a tender, full lower belly.

causes.title: Period pain
causes.signs: Cramping low central pain around periods.

causes.title: Pelvic infection (PID)
causes.signs: Low pain with fever, unusual discharge or pain during sex.

causes.title: Endometriosis
causes.signs: Severe period pain, pain during sex or when opening the bowels, and pelvic pain that lasts for months.

causes.title: Prostatitis
causes.signs: Deep pain low in the pelvis or between the scrotum and anus, with burning or difficulty passing urine, sometimes fever.

causes.title: Constipation
causes.signs: Cramps and bloating with hard or infrequent stools.

causes.title: Pregnancy-related pain
causes.signs: Any significant lower abdominal pain in pregnancy, or with a missed period, should be assessed promptly.

causes.title: Diverticulitis
causes.signs: Pain here with fever and tenderness, mostly in older adults.

causes.title: Constipation / IBS
causes.signs: Cramping and bloating linked to bowel habit.

causes.title: Inguinal hernia
causes.signs: A groin bulge when standing or straining.

causes.title: Kidney stone
causes.signs: Severe pain moving from the side down toward the groin.

causes.title: Ectopic pregnancy
causes.signs: One-sided low pain in someone who could be pregnant, often with vaginal bleeding, pain at the tip of the shoulder, dizziness or fainting. It is an emergency.

causes.title: Ovarian cyst or torsion
causes.signs: A cyst can cause a dull one-sided ache. Sudden, severe pain with vomiting can mean the ovary has twisted, which is an emergency.

causes.title: Inflammatory bowel disease
causes.signs: Recurring pain with bloody diarrhoea or urgency.

regions.name: Genitals

causes.title: Urinary tract infection
causes.signs: Burning or stinging when passing urine, needing to go often, cloudy or smelly urine. Fever, shivering or pain in the side means the kidneys may be involved.

causes.title: Sexually transmitted infection
causes.signs: Unusual discharge, burning when passing urine, sores, blisters or lumps. Many have no symptoms. Sexual health clinics test and treat confidentially.

causes.title: Thrush
causes.signs: Itching and soreness of the vulva with a thick white discharge. A pharmacy treatment works for most; see a doctor if it keeps coming back.

causes.title: Bartholin’s cyst
causes.signs: A swelling on one side of the vaginal opening. A painful, hot, growing one may be an abscess.

causes.title: Vulval pain
causes.signs: Burning, stinging or soreness of the vulva lasting months, sometimes only on touch or during sex.

causes.title: Testicular torsion
causes.signs: Sudden, severe pain in one testicle, often with swelling, belly pain and vomiting, most often in teenagers. It is an emergency: surgery within hours saves the testicle.

causes.title: Epididymitis
causes.signs: Pain and swelling at the back of a testicle building up over a day or two, sometimes with fever or burning when passing urine.

causes.title: Testicular lump
causes.signs: A painless lump, a swelling or a heavy feeling in the scrotum. Most lumps are harmless, but all need checking.

causes.title: Hernia into the scrotum
causes.signs: A bulge that comes down into the scrotum when standing or straining. A tender, hard swelling that won’t go back is urgent.

causes.title: Pudendal neuralgia
causes.signs: Burning or stabbing pain in the genitals or perineum, worse sitting and eased by standing or lying down.

redFlags.text: Sudden, severe pain in a testicle
An erection lasting more than four hours
Heavy bleeding, or severe pain, in pregnancy

redFlags: Being unable to pass urine
Numbness around the genitals or buttocks with new bladder or bowel problems (possible cauda equina syndrome)

regions.name: Hip & groin

causes.title: Hip osteoarthritis
causes.signs: Groin or thigh pain and stiffness, worse with walking, trouble with shoes and socks.

causes.title: Groin strain
causes.signs: Pain on the inner thigh after kicking, sprinting or changing direction.

causes.title: Hip fracture
causes.signs: An older person who can’t bear weight after a fall.

causes.title: Outer hip pain (gluteal tendinopathy)
causes.signs: Pain on the outer hip, worse lying on that side or climbing stairs.

causes.title: Inguinal hernia
causes.signs: A groin bulge when standing or straining.

causes.title: Pain spreading from a testicle
causes.signs: A problem in the testicle, such as torsion or epididymitis, is often felt in the groin. Sudden, severe pain is an emergency.

causes.title: Pain from the back
causes.signs: Hip or buttock pain with back stiffness, sometimes running down the leg.

redFlags: A child with a limp and fever, or who refuses to walk
An older person who can’t bear weight after a fall

redFlags.text: Sudden, severe pain in a testicle, or groin pain with a swollen scrotum

regions.name: Front of thigh

causes.title: Thigh strain
causes.signs: A sudden pull at the front or inner thigh while sprinting, kicking or changing direction.

causes.title: Dead leg
causes.signs: A painful, stiff thigh after a knee or a blow to the front of the thigh, with bruising. It settles over days to weeks.

causes.title: Meralgia paresthetica
causes.signs: Burning or numbness on the outer thigh from a squeezed skin nerve.

causes.title: Deep vein thrombosis (DVT)
causes.signs: A swollen, warm, painful leg, often after travel, surgery or immobility.

causes.title: Femur fracture
causes.signs: Severe pain and deformity after major trauma.

causes.title: Referred pain
causes.signs: Thigh pain can come from the hip or the lower back.

redFlags: A swollen, painful leg with breathlessness or chest pain: call emergency services
Severe pain and swelling after a blow that keeps getting worse

regions.name: Back of thigh

causes.title: Hamstring strain
causes.signs: A sudden sharp pain or pull at the back of the thigh while sprinting or kicking, sometimes with bruising a day or two later.

causes.title: Hamstring tear
causes.signs: A pop with sudden weakness and a lot of bruising down the back of the thigh. A tear near the sitting bone may need repair.

causes.title: Sciatica
causes.signs: Pain running from the buttock down the back of the thigh, often past the knee, with tingling or numbness. It usually comes from the lower back.

causes.title: Cramp
causes.signs: A brief, hard tightening of the muscle, often at night or during exercise.

causes.title: Deep vein thrombosis (DVT)
causes.signs: A swollen, warm, painful leg, often after travel, surgery or being unwell in bed.

redFlags: A swollen, painful leg with breathlessness or chest pain: call emergency services
Numbness around the genitals or buttocks, new bladder or bowel problems, or weakness in both legs: emergency (possible cauda equina syndrome)
A leg that is getting weaker

regions.name: Knee

causes.title: Patellofemoral pain
causes.signs: Ache around the kneecap on stairs, squatting or after sitting.

causes.title: Patellar tendinopathy
causes.signs: Pain just below the kneecap when jumping, squatting or climbing stairs, common in jumping sports.

causes.title: Ligament injury (ACL / MCL)
causes.signs: A twist or pop with swelling and a knee that gives way.

causes.title: Meniscus tear
causes.signs: Joint-line pain, catching or locking after a twist.

causes.title: Osteoarthritis
causes.signs: Pain and stiffness in older adults, worse with activity.

causes.title: IT band syndrome
causes.signs: Sharp pain on the outer knee in runners and cyclists, worse going downhill.

causes.title: Bursitis
causes.signs: A swelling over or below the kneecap after kneeling a lot.

causes.title: Baker’s cyst
causes.signs: A swelling or tight feeling behind the knee, often alongside arthritis. A suddenly swollen, painful calf needs checking for a clot (DVT).

causes.title: Hot, swollen knee
causes.signs: A red, hot, swollen knee, with or without fever, can be gout or infection.

redFlags: A hot, swollen joint with fever
Unable to bear weight or straighten the knee after an injury

regions.name: Back of the knee

causes.title: Baker’s cyst
causes.signs: A soft swelling behind the knee, tight when you bend it, often with arthritis or a meniscus tear. If it bursts, the calf becomes swollen and painful like a blood clot, so get that checked the same day.

causes.title: Hamstring tendon strain
causes.signs: Pain at the inner or outer back of the knee after sprinting or kicking, worse bending the knee against resistance.

causes.title: Calf strain
causes.signs: A sudden pull at the top of the calf during a push-off, then pain on walking or rising on tiptoe.

causes.title: Popliteus strain
causes.signs: Pain at the back and outer side of the knee, worse walking or running downhill.

causes.title: Meniscus tear
causes.signs: Pain deep in the back of the knee on squatting or twisting, sometimes with catching or locking.

causes.title: PCL injury
causes.signs: Pain at the back of the knee after a blow to the front of the shin with the knee bent, or a fall onto the bent knee.

causes.title: Deep vein thrombosis (DVT)
causes.signs: A swollen, warm, painful calf or back of the knee, especially after travel, surgery or illness.

causes.title: Pain from the back (sciatica)
causes.signs: Pain behind the knee as part of a line of pain from the buttock down the back of the leg, often with tingling or numbness.

causes.title: Popliteal artery aneurysm or entrapment
causes.signs: A pulsing lump behind the knee in an older adult, or calf cramping on exercise in a young athlete that settles at rest.

redFlags: A swollen, warm, painful calf: same-day assessment (possible DVT)
Sudden breathlessness or chest pain with a swollen leg: call emergency services
A cold, pale, numb or painful foot
A badly injured knee that looks out of shape: emergency care (a dislocated knee can tear the artery behind it)

regions.name: Shin

causes.title: Shin splints
causes.signs: Diffuse pain along the inner shin with running.

causes.title: Stress fracture
causes.signs: One very tender spot on the shin that is getting worse.

causes.title: Exercise compartment pain
causes.signs: A tight, aching front of the shin that builds up during running and eases with rest, sometimes with tingling on top of the foot.

causes.title: Knock to the shin
causes.signs: A painful lump after knocking the shin. The thin skin over the bone can be slow to heal.

causes.title: Cellulitis
causes.signs: A red, hot, swollen, tender patch of skin that spreads, sometimes with a fever.

redFlags: Severe, increasing pain after an injury or in a tight cast
Red, hot, swollen skin that is spreading fast, with a fever or feeling very unwell

regions.name: Calf

causes.title: Calf strain
causes.signs: A sudden pull or a feeling of being struck in the calf when pushing off, followed by tightness.

causes.title: Cramp
causes.signs: Brief, intense tightening, often at night.

causes.title: Achilles tendinopathy
causes.signs: Pain and stiffness in the tendon just above the heel, worst in the morning or at the start of exercise.

causes.title: Varicose veins
causes.signs: Bulging, twisted veins with aching or heavy legs, worse at the end of the day.

causes.title: Sciatica felt in the calf
causes.signs: Pain or tingling down the back of the leg into the calf or foot, coming from a nerve root in the lower back.

causes.title: Poor circulation (claudication)
causes.signs: Cramping calf pain on walking that eases with rest.

causes.title: Deep vein thrombosis (DVT)
causes.signs: A swollen, warm, tender calf, especially after travel, surgery or immobility.

causes.title: Achilles tendon rupture
causes.signs: A sudden snap, or a feeling of being kicked in the back of the ankle, then trouble walking or standing on tiptoe.

redFlags: A swollen, painful calf with breathlessness or chest pain: call emergency services (possible blood clot in the lung)
Severe, increasing pain after an injury or in a tight cast
A cold, pale or blue foot or leg

regions.name: Ankle & foot

causes.title: Ankle sprain
causes.signs: Swelling and bruising after rolling the ankle. If you can’t take four steps or the bone is tender, get it checked.

causes.title: Fracture
causes.signs: Unable to bear weight, or tenderness right on the bone.

causes.title: Plantar fasciitis
causes.signs: Heel pain with the first steps in the morning.

causes.title: Achilles tendon problem
causes.signs: Pain or thickening above the heel. A sudden snap means a possible rupture and is urgent.

causes.title: Inner ankle pain / flattening arch
causes.signs: Pain and swelling behind the inner ankle bone, with the arch slowly dropping. A common cause of adult flat foot.

causes.title: Gout
causes.signs: A sudden, very painful, red, hot big-toe joint.

causes.title: Bunion / Morton’s neuroma
causes.signs: A bump at the big-toe joint, or burning pain between the toes.

causes.title: Diabetic foot problems
causes.signs: Any wound, colour change or swelling on the foot of someone with diabetes needs prompt review.

redFlags: A cold, pale or blue foot
A hot, swollen joint with fever
An open wound over a broken bone

regions.name: Heel

causes.title: Plantar fasciitis
causes.signs: Sharp pain under the heel with the first steps in the morning or after sitting, easing as you walk.

causes.title: Achilles tendinopathy
causes.signs: Pain and stiffness in the cord above the heel, worst in the morning or at the start of exercise.

causes.title: Achilles rupture
causes.signs: A sudden snap, as if kicked in the heel, then you can't push off or stand on tiptoe.

causes.title: Sever’s disease
causes.signs: Heel pain in an active child of about 8 to 14, worse with running and jumping, where the Achilles pulls on the growing heel bone. It settles with growth.

causes.title: Heel stress fracture
causes.signs: Heel pain that builds with walking or running and the whole heel is tender when squeezed, after a rise in activity.

causes.title: Trapped nerve (tarsal tunnel)
causes.signs: Burning, tingling or numbness under the heel and sole, sometimes worse at night.

causes.title: Heel bump and bursitis (Haglund’s)
causes.signs: A tender, sometimes red bump at the back of the heel where the shoe rubs, just below the Achilles tendon.

causes.title: Bruised heel pad
causes.signs: A deep ache in the middle of the heel pad, worse walking barefoot on hard floors, often after a jump or a landing.

causes.title: Inflammatory heel pain
causes.signs: Pain in both heels, or at the Achilles and under the heel together, with morning back stiffness, psoriasis or swollen joints elsewhere.

redFlags: A sudden snap at the back of the heel and you can't push off or stand on tiptoe
A hot, red, swollen heel or foot with fever, or a new wound on the foot if you have diabetes
Heel pain after a fall from a height that stops you bearing weight
A cold, pale or numb foot, or a heel sore that isn't healing

regions.name: Upper back

causes.title: Postural strain
causes.signs: Aching between the shoulder blades after long sitting.

causes.title: Rib joint sprain
causes.signs: Sharp pain beside the spine when breathing or twisting.

causes.title: Osteoporotic fracture
causes.signs: Sudden mid-back pain after minor strain in someone with thin bones.

causes.title: Shingles
causes.signs: A burning band of pain followed by a rash on one side.

causes.title: Referred pain
causes.signs: The heart, aorta, gallbladder or pancreas can cause upper-back pain.

causes.title: Pinched nerve in the neck
causes.signs: Pain between or over a shoulder blade, often with neck pain and pins and needles, numbness or weakness down one arm.

causes.title: Pleurisy or chest infection
causes.signs: Sharp pain on breathing in or coughing, with a cough, fever or breathlessness.

causes.title: Rounded upper back in a teenager (Scheuermann’s disease)
causes.signs: An aching, stiff upper back and a curve that doesn't straighten when standing tall, usually noticed in the early teens.

redFlags: Sudden, severe tearing pain between the shoulder blades
Back pain with chest pain or breathlessness
Back pain with fever, unexplained weight loss or a history of cancer
New numbness or weakness in the arms or legs, or bladder or bowel problems

regions.name: Mid back

causes.title: Muscle strain
causes.signs: Aching or sharp pain beside the spine after lifting, twisting or long sitting, worse with some movements. Staying active helps.

causes.title: Rib joint sprain
causes.signs: Sharp, one-sided pain beside the spine that catches on breathing in, twisting or coughing.

causes.title: Osteoporotic fracture
causes.signs: Sudden mid-back pain after a minor strain, cough or fall in someone over 60 or with thin bones, sometimes with loss of height.

causes.title: Shingles
causes.signs: Burning or tingling pain in a band around one side of the chest and back, followed a few days later by a blistering rash. See a doctor early for antiviral treatment.

causes.title: Kidney infection or stone
causes.signs: Pain at the bottom of the ribs on one side of the back, with fever, shivering or urinary symptoms, or waves of severe pain spreading to the groin.

causes.title: Pain from the gut
causes.signs: Gallstones, a stomach ulcer or pancreatitis can be felt in the middle of the back, often after eating and with pain in the upper abdomen.

causes.title: Pleurisy or chest infection
causes.signs: Sharp pain in the side of the back on breathing in or coughing, with a cough, fever or breathlessness.

causes.title: Inflammatory back pain
causes.signs: Stiffness that is worst in the morning, lasts over 30 minutes and eases with exercise, starting before 40. Sometimes with pain where the ribs meet the spine.

redFlags: Sudden, severe tearing pain in the back: call emergency services (possible aortic dissection)
Back pain with chest pain, breathlessness or sweating: call emergency services
Back pain with fever, unexplained weight loss or a history of cancer
New numbness or weakness in the legs, or bladder or bowel problems
Back pain after a serious fall or accident

regions.name: Lower back

causes.title: Lower back pain
causes.signs: Pain and stiffness after lifting, bending or nothing in particular. Usually settles within weeks, and staying active helps.

causes.title: Sciatica
causes.signs: Pain shooting down the back of the leg, often with tingling.

causes.title: Sacroiliac joint pain
causes.signs: One-sided low-back and buttock pain, worse on stairs or rolling in bed.

causes.title: Kidney stone or infection
causes.signs: Pain higher up in the side or back, with fever or urinary symptoms.

causes.title: Spinal stenosis
causes.signs: Leg pain or heaviness on walking, relieved by sitting or bending forward.

causes.title: Inflammatory back pain
causes.signs: Stiffness worst in the morning, lasting over 30 minutes and easing with exercise, starting before 40.

causes.title: Osteoporotic fracture
causes.signs: Sudden pain in the lower back after a minor strain, cough or fall in someone over 60 or with thin bones, sometimes with loss of height.

causes.title: Period pain or endometriosis
causes.signs: A dull ache in the lower back and lower abdomen around periods. Pain that is severe, getting worse, or there between periods needs a doctor.

causes.title: Prostate inflammation (prostatitis)
causes.signs: Aching in the lower back, between the legs or in the tip of the penis, with painful or frequent passing of urine, sometimes with fever.

causes.title: Abdominal aortic aneurysm
causes.signs: A widened aorta usually causes no symptoms, but if it leaks it causes sudden, severe pain in the lower back or belly, often with feeling faint. Most likely in men over 65 and smokers. This is an emergency.

redFlags: Numbness around the genitals or buttocks, new bladder or bowel problems, or weakness in both legs: emergency (possible cauda equina syndrome)
Back pain with fever, unexplained weight loss, a history of cancer, or after significant trauma
Severe pain that is worse at night and doesn’t ease with rest
Sudden, severe lower back or belly pain in an older adult, especially with fainting: call emergency services (possible leaking aortic aneurysm)

regions.name: Tailbone

causes.title: Tailbone pain (coccydynia)
causes.signs: Pain at the very bottom of the spine, worse sitting or getting up from a chair, often after a fall or childbirth.

causes.title: Bruised or broken tailbone
causes.signs: Pain after a fall onto your bottom, worse when sitting or getting up. It usually settles over a few weeks, and a cushion with a gap at the back helps.

causes.title: Pilonidal abscess
causes.signs: A painful, swollen, sometimes discharging lump in the skin at the top of the buttock crease.

causes.title: Piles or a tear at the back passage
causes.signs: Pain or itching around the back passage when opening your bowels, sometimes with bright red blood on the paper. Bleeding that keeps happening, or at over 50, should be checked by a doctor.

causes.title: Pain from the lower back
causes.signs: The lower spine and the sacroiliac joints can cause an ache that is felt down at the tailbone.

redFlags: Numbness around the genitals or buttocks, new bladder or bowel problems, or weakness in both legs: emergency (possible cauda equina syndrome)
A hot, swollen, very painful lump near the tailbone or back passage with fever
Tailbone pain with fever, unexplained weight loss or a history of cancer

regions.name: Buttock

causes.title: Sciatica
causes.signs: Pain from the buttock shooting down the back of the leg, often with tingling or numbness. It usually comes from an irritated nerve root in the lower back.

causes.title: Piriformis syndrome
causes.signs: A deep ache in the middle of the buttock, worse sitting or on stairs, sometimes with tingling down the back of the thigh.

causes.title: Sacroiliac joint pain
causes.signs: One-sided pain over the dimple at the top of the buttock, worse on stairs, standing up or rolling in bed.

causes.title: Gluteal muscle strain
causes.signs: Aching or tightness in the buttock after running, climbing or a sudden effort, easing over days to weeks.

causes.title: Sitting-bone pain (high hamstring tendinopathy)
causes.signs: Deep pain at the bottom of the buttock, worse sitting on hard chairs or running uphill.

causes.title: Pain from the hip
causes.signs: Hip arthritis can ache in the buttock as well as the groin, with stiffness putting on shoes and socks.

causes.title: Ischiofemoral impingement
causes.signs: A deep ache low in the buttock, worse with long strides or when the thigh is turned in, from the quadratus femoris being pinched between the sitting bone and the femur.

causes.title: Hamstring tear at the sitting bone
causes.signs: A sudden sharp pain or pop at the bottom of the buttock while sprinting, water-skiing or doing the splits, followed by bruising down the back of the thigh. A complete tear may need surgery within weeks, so see a doctor promptly.

redFlags: Numbness around the genitals or buttocks, new bladder or bowel problems, or weakness in both legs: emergency (possible cauda equina syndrome)
A leg that is getting weaker, or buttock pain with fever or feeling very unwell
Unable to bear weight after a fall
Severe pain in the hip or buttock after a fall, with a leg that looks shorter or turned outwards: possible broken hip
